title: WPMS/1368/2015 of Mohd Safi AND OTHERS Vs Union Of India AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1368 of 2015
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. M.C. Kandpal, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. Manish Bisht, Advocate for
the petitioners.
Mr. A.K. Joshi, Addl. C.S.C. for the
State/respondents.
Mr. M.C. Kandpal, learned Senior
Counsel appearing for the petitioners,
submits that Division Bench of this Court,
vide judgment dated 12.5.2015, was pleased
to dispose of Writ Petition (PIL) No. 168 of
2014, Shri Krishna v. Union of India &
others; Division Bench of this Court was
pleased to hold that allocation of the land
after obtaining permission from the Central
Government under the Forest (Conservation)
Act for the purpose of rehabilitation of
Gujjars cannot be seen as an act of illegality
requiring interference in public interest
litigation. Mr. Kandpal further contends that
Mr. A.S. Rawat, learned Additional
Advocate General has made factually
incorrect statement on the basis of
instructions received by him that after the
reallocation of Gujjars, there is no more
Gujjars remaining for being reallocated in
the Corbett area. According to Mr. M.C.
Kandpal, learned Senior Counsel, petitioners
are also residing in Sona River Wildlife
Sanctuary-Kalagarh Tiger Reserve (Corbett
Tiger Reserve), therefore, petitioners should
also be rehabilitated; however, names of the
petitioners have not been recorded in the list

prepared by the Forest Department. Mr.
Kandpal further contends that petitioners
would like to move a
modification/clarification application before
the Division Bench in Writ Petition (PIL)
No. 168 of 2014 seeking direction that before
affecting the reallocation or rehabilitation,
survey should be made on the spot and
whosoever is found in possession, including
the petitioners, should be rehabilitated;
therefore, he may be permitted to withdraw
this petition with the aforesaid liberty.
Order accordingly.
CLMA No. 6623 of 2015 also stands
disposed of accordingly.
(Alok Singh, J.)
Dated 17.06.2015
Avneet/
